lineage.description: Population in need (PiN) calculated by integrating DANE census data on WASH infrastructure coverage (unimproved water sources, lack of sewerage, waste collection) with health surveillance data (SIVIGILA disease rates, malnutrition, UNGRD disaster registries) and environmental factors (IRCA water quality, El Niño/La Niña phenomena). Severity scores were computed for each indicator, weighted and aggregated to produce final PiN estimates disaggregated by municipality, age group, gender, ethnicity, and disability status for the WASH cluster humanitarian response.

sources.name: DANE (Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística)
sources.description: National census and administrative statistics providing baseline population counts, age disaggregation, and WASH infrastructure coverage indicators (unimproved water sources, lack of sewerage, waste collection)

sources.name: UNGRD (Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres)
sources.description: Disaster risk management agency data on disaster-affected populations and emergency registries

sources.name: SIVIGILA (Sistema de Vigilancia en Salud Pública)
sources.description: Public health surveillance system providing disease rates related to inadequate water and sanitation use

sources.name: MONITOR
sources.description: Monitoring system contributing health and nutrition indicators for severity assessment

sources.name: IRCA (Índice de Riesgo de la Calidad del Agua)
sources.description: Water quality risk index used to adjust severity calculations
